description: Every ThreatLocker Portal API feature, plus the write operations the read-only tools lack and a cross-tenant offline store no other ThreatLocker tool has.

tools.name: application-files_list

tools.name: applications_create

tools.name: applications_get

tools.name: applications_research

tools.name: applications_search

tools.name: approvals_permit-options

tools.name: computers_baseline-rescan

tools.name: computers_checkins

tools.name: computers_delete
tools.description: Delete/remove computers by id. Required: computer-ids. Returns the new ActionResult.

tools.name: computers_enable-protection

tools.name: computers_get
tools.description: Get a single computer's detail by id. Required: computer-id. Returns the Computer.

tools.name: computers_install-info
tools.description: Deployment/install info for adding new computers. Returns the InstallInfo.

tools.name: computers_list
tools.description: List/search computers (paginated). searchBy 1-5; orderBy e.g. computername. Optional: page-number (default: 1), page-size (default: 100), search-text (plus 7 more). Returns array of Computer.

tools.name: computers_maintenance

tools.name: computers_maintenance-update

tools.name: computers_move-org
tools.description: Move computers to another organization (tenant). Required: computer-ids, target-org. Returns the new ActionResult.

tools.name: computers_restart-service
tools.description: Restart the ThreatLocker service on computers. Required: computer-ids. Returns the new ActionResult.

tools.name: maintenance_history

tools.name: network-policies_get

tools.name: network-policies_list

tools.description: List child/managed organizations (paginated). Optional: search-text, all-children (default: true), order-by (default: name) (plus 3 more). Returns array of Organization.

tools.name: policies_copy
tools.description: Copy policies from a source org/group to target org(s) — cross-tenant cloning. Required: source-applies-to, source-org, target-applies-to. Optional: os-type (default: 1). Returns the new ActionResult.

tools.name: policies_create
tools.description: Create a policy. policyActionId 1=Permit,2=Deny,6=Permit+Ringfence. Required: name, computer-group. Optional: os-type (default: 1), action (default: 1), enabled (default: true) (plus 1 more). Returns the new Policy.

tools.name: policies_delete

tools.name: policies_deploy

tools.name: policies_get

tools.name: policies_list-by-app
tools.description: List policies that target an application (paginated). Required: application-id, organization-id. Optional: page-number (default: 1), page-size (default: 100), include-denies (default: false). Returns array of Policy.

tools.name: reports_data

tools.name: reports_list

tools.name: scheduled-actions_get
tools.description: Get a single scheduled action by id. Required: scheduled-action-id. Returns the ScheduledAction.

tools.name: scheduled-actions_search
tools.description: Search scheduled actions (paginated). Optional: order-by (default: scheduleddatetime), ascending (default: true), page-number (default: 1) (plus 1 more). Returns array of ScheduledAction.

tools.name: storage-policies_get
tools.description: Get a single storage policy by id. Required: storage-policy-id. Returns the StoragePolicy.

tools.name: storage-policies_list
tools.description: List storage policies (paginated). Optional: page-number (default: 1), page-size (default: 100), search-text. Returns array of StoragePolicy.

tools.name: system-audit_search
tools.description: Search portal admin/system audit entries. Requires startDate/endDate. Required: start, end. Optional: page-number (default: 1), page-size (default: 100), username (plus 4 more). Returns array of SystemAuditEntry.

tools.name: tags_dropdown
tools.description: Tag dropdown options (label/value). Optional: include-built-ins (default: false), tag-type (default: 1). Returns array of Dropdown.

tools.name: tags_get

tools.name: versions_list
tools.description: List available agent versions (label/value/isEnabled/isDefault/osType). Returns array of Version.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant approval triage
novel_features.description: One ranked queue of every pending application approval across all your managed customer tenants, grouped by file hash so duplicate requests collapse into one row.

novel_features.name: Batch-approve by hash
novel_features.description: Approve the same file (by SHA256) across every tenant where it is pending, in one command, with a dry-run plan first.

novel_features.name: Audit retention rescue
novel_features.description: Export the Unified Audit log per-tenant or across all tenants to JSONL/CSV and persist it locally, keeping evidence past ThreatLocker's 31-day retention cliff.

novel_features.name: Retention-cliff doctor
novel_features.description: Reports, per tenant, the oldest audit row you have versus the 31-day cliff and how stale your last export is — flagging tenants about to lose evidence.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant audit drift
novel_features.description: One ranked table of security-relevant changes — protection disabled, policy changed, maintenance toggled — across every tenant in a time window.

novel_features.name: Device-health rollup
novel_features.description: Joins computers, online-devices, and last-checkin data to classify every endpoint healthy / offline / stale / isolated, rolled up per tenant.

novel_features.name: Auth / 401 doctor
novel_features.description: Diagnoses the #1 ThreatLocker integration pain: validates the raw 64-hex token format, the no-Bearer Authorization header, the ManagedOrganizationId header, New-vs-Old API mode, pings an authenticated endpoint, and maps a 401 to its exact likely cause.

novel_features.name: Cross-tenant application hunt
novel_features.description: Locate a specific file (by hash, certificate, or path) across every tenant and endpoint in one offline query — present, approved, or pending.

novel_features.name: Open-maintenance sweep
novel_features.description: Lists every endpoint whose maintenance-mode window is open right now across all tenants, longest-open first, flagging windows open past an age threshold.

novel_features.name: Per-tenant posture card
novel_features.description: One row per managed tenant from the local store: endpoint count, online and isolated endpoints, pending approvals, open maintenance windows and the age of the newest audit row.

novel_features.name: Audit archive pull
novel_features.description: Pages the Unified Audit and portal system-audit searches for a time window into the local store, so audit export, drift, retention-check and posture have rows past the 31-day cliff.
